Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase here! The Afghanistan players make their way out into the middle now. The openers for Zimbabwe, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe and Tarisai Musakanda follow them out too. Fazal Haque to open the bowling here.

Right then! The target for Zimbabwe is 184 runs in 20 overs. Again a huge mountain to chase. Can they show a spirited effort with the bat to scale this one down and get a consolation win? Or will Afghanistan prevail for one last time on this tour to seal the series 3-0? Join us to find out as the chase unfolds shortly after the break.

Usman Ghani is in for a chat! He says that the wicket was low at the start of the innings and they are happy with the total they got. Adds that they were trying to rotate the strike and he was aware that Zadran and Afghan can come along and hit the ball well.

Zimbabwe, with the ball, were brilliant for the most part of the innings. They bowled tight lines and lengths and did not allow the Afghanistan batsmen to get on them. But the death bowling which has been their issue came to haunt them again as they leaked runs towards the end to hand the advantage back to Afghanistan. Blessing Muzarabani and Richard Ngarava were the best of the lot as they took a couple of wickets as the others were carted at the death. Raza, Akram and Maskadza managed to get a wicket apiece too. Overall a mixed bowling effort from Zimbabwe sees them chase a mountain of runs again to get a consolation win.

Having opted to bat, Afghanistan once again failed to get a strong start as they lost Gurbaz early. But Usman Ghani and Karim Janat tried to stitch a stand but both were dismissed in quick succession, and to add to it, the Man of the Match from the last game, Mohammad Nabi followed them quickly. Afghanistan were reeling at 96/4 before some late hitting from Najibullah Zadran and Asghar Afghan see them post a score in excess of 180 runs. Though Afghan departed but Zadran continued to bring up his 4th T20I fifty and ended unbeaten on 72 runs.

The fatigue of playing back-to-back games has certainly taken a toll on Afghanistan players as they struggled to find the fence regularly and with the pitch slowing up too, it made their stroke-making a lot difficult. Still, they manage to post a competitive score in the end. Praise to Zimbabwe too as they were superb in the field as they saved a few runs and also effected a few brilliant catches but a poor death bowling effort sees them stare at yet another huge total to chase.

SIX! What a way to finish the over and the innings! Najibullah Zadran finishes on 72 and he has played really well. On a good length, around off, Najibullah Zadran cracks this one over the long on region for a massive biggie. Afghanistan finish on 183/7.
On a length and outside off, Zadran lofts this behind the cover region in no man's land for a couple of runs, as the fielder runs to his left and stops the ball.

FOUR! In the gap and another boundary. A full toss, around off, probably looking for the yorker but Blessing missed out and Najibullah Zadran opens the face of the bat and steers this behind point for a boundary.
FOUR! No hat-trick but a boundary. A full ball, in the slot, around off, Najibullah Zadran slams this one over mid off and gets a one bounce four.
Hashmatullah Shahidi is the new man in. Najibullah Zadran will face the Hat-Trick ball.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ashraf came, Ashraf saw, Ashraf did not do anything and Ashraf goes back! First ball duck for him too. Short of a length ball around off, Sharafuddin Ashraf looks to pull this one and does so too, but it is not the best timed shot and he holes out to Wellington Masakadza at deep mid-wicket. Blessing Muzarabani on a hat-trick now!
Sharafuddin Ashraf is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The champ goes back for a golden duck. Blessing Muzarabani runs in and bowls a slower short ball outside off, Rashid Khan has to reach out and looks to slap this one away but only manages a thick outside edge. The keeper, Richmond Mutumbami does the rest. The first wicket for Blessing too.
FOUR! Another one! A full ball, on the pads, flicked through backward square leg for a boundary. 17 runs and a wicket of the penultimate over of the innings.

SIX! WHAM! FIFTY FOR ZADRAN! A wonderful knock by Zadran and he has helped Afghanistan reach a good total in this game. Will want to finish the innings well too. Fuller, around off, Najibullah Zadran slams this one over long on for a biggie.
A yorker and outside off, Najibullah Zadran looks to slam this one away but fails to get bat on ball.
Fuller and on middle, worked to the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Rashid Khan is the new man in with the bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afghan was looking very dangerous and the skipper of Afghanistan goes back now. The first scalp for Akram. A full ball, outside off, Asghar Afghan lofts this one towards long off, looking to clear the man there but fails to time it all that well. Holes out to Wellington Masakadza, who takes a good catch. A good knock though, of 24 runs.

FOUR! Good shot! A length ball, full, outside off, Asghar Afghan opens up the face of the bat and guides this one behind point for a boundary. The man at third man, ran to his right but could not stop the ball.
WIDE. Starts off with a wayward delivery outside off, Asghar leaves it be. Wide signalled.
SIX! 150 up for Afghanistan! On a length, around off, Najibullah Zadran slams this one way over deep mid-wicket.
Fuller and outside off, Najibullah Zadran looks to push this one away but fails to get any bat on this.
Richard Ngarava is back on.
Around off, length, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, Afghan looks to slash this one away but misses to connect his shot.

SIX! Another six and Afghanistan are turning it up now, towards the end! A low full toss on off, Asghar Afghan just lofts this one with power over the long on region. There was a man there, but he was just a mere spectator there.
On a good length and around off, AA lofts this one over covers and the ball lands safe. Two runs.
Richard Ngarava is back on.

FOUR! A freebie and Najibullah Zadran does not miss out. A full toss, on the body, Najibullah Zadran just swivels and pulls this one with power to the fine leg fence. 21 off this one. A very expensive over.
SIX! Straight as an arrow! Powerfully hit! Flighted, around off, Najibullah Zadran clears his front leg and tonks this one over the bowler's head for a biggie.
SIX! This one was nailed! Cracking shot! Full, tossed up, around off, in the slot as Najibullah Zadran slog sweeps this one over deep mid-wicket.
Flatter and on the pads now, flicked away to deep square leg. The batters exchange ends now.
On middle, slogged away to deep square leg for a single.
Full and tossed up around off, Zadran lofts this one over the cover region for a couple of runs.
WIDE. Slipped down the leg side, NZ misses his flick. Wided.

An appeal for caught behind but turned down. A yorker, outside off, AA swings his blade at this but misses and the ball goes to the keeper. A loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. After being tonked for a six, Blessing Muzarabani finishes the over off well.
Fuller, outside off, punched down the ground, to long off, for a single.
Fuller and angling away from the right-hander, Zadran drives this one to the cover fielder.
Full toss on off, bunted to the long off region for a single.

SIX! You offer width and bowl this one short, then the Afghanistan skipper is not going to miss out. Short, outside off, Asghar Afghan swivels and sends the ball sailing over the deep mid-wicket fence.
Around off, on a length, Zadran pushes this one to point for a quick single.
Quicker and straighter on off, pushed down to long on for a single.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter on leg, Zadran pulls it to deep square leg where a slight fumble there allows the batsmen to come back for the second run.
Fired fuller on off, Asghar digs it out to covers for a single.
Floated on leg, Afghan clips it to short fine leg and takes a single. The fielder there fires a throw at the keeper who cannot collect it cleanly. Another run conceded due to the sloppy fielding.
Fuller on the pads, Zadran whips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Full on middle, turned to leg side.
WIDE! Full and outside off, Zadran leaves it. Wide called.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wellington Masakadza is late to react but in the end, he makes it well to grab a fantastic catch. Short of a good length and outside off, Nabi looks to go inside out over covers but ends up slicing it over to sweeper cover where Masakadza is late to start but in the end, he catches it brilliantly, coming ahead from his position. Zimbabwe have been phenomenal in the field today.
Time for the skipper, Asghar Afghan to make his way out now!
Short and around off, Nabi looks to go for the pull but the ball goes over him. Nabi anticipates it to be called as a wide but it is not to be.
1000 T20I runs for Najibullah Zadran! He gets to the milestone by tucking this in-angler off his pads to mid-wicket.
Back of a length and around off, Nabi plays it down to long on for a single.
Short and outside off, Zadran cuts it to backward point.
Sliding on middle and leg, Nabi plays it to wide mid on for a single.
Richard Ngarava comes back on. 2-0-16-1 so far.
Shortish outside off, Nabi pushes it to covers.
Quicker one on the pads, tucked to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Deft placement! Flatter and outside off, Najibullah Zadran runs it down to third man for a boundary.
Floated around off, Zadran slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Straighter this time on off, Zadran pushes it down to long on for a single.
Floated around off, Zadran blocks it out.
Brilliant fielding from the fielder there. Flatter and outside off, Zadran cuts it powerfully through point as the fielder near the fence dives to his right and saves a couple of runs.
On off, Zadran keeps it out safely.
Time for the President, Mohammad Nabi to come out!

OUT! CAUGHT! Sikandar Raza strikes! Ghani has a brain-fade after going for a six on the previous ball. Raza tosses it again and around off, Ghani this time eyes the fence on the off side as he goes for hoick. He though gets the height but not the distance as the ball can only go as far as mid off where Ryan Burl takes the catch. Two set batsmen depart for Afghanistan.
SIX! Slogged! Loopy around off, Ghani goes onto his knee and slogs it up and over deep square leg for a biggie. The fielder there looked interested but he ended up just ball watching.
Sikandar Raza to roll his arm again. Gave 5 runs off his first over.
On middle, Ghani flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated around off, Zadran punches it off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Flatter and outside off, tapped to point.
Who will come out now? It is Najibullah Zadran.

OUT! CASTLED! Janat departs looking to accelerate! Wellington Maskadza gets the breakthrough! Floated around off, Janat goes for a big heave to the leg side off the back foot but is early into the shot this time. He misses it to see the ball crash into the middle pole. A wicket at the right time for Zimbabwe. Can they capitalize on this opening?
Angled on middle, Janat blocks it off the back foot.
Floated around off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Wellington Masakadza is back on.
SIX! Ends the over very well. Has done well to fetch 17 runs off the over. A length ball, outside off, Karim Janat slams this one over the mid off region and into the ropes downtown.

FOUR! Uses the depth of the crease and gets a boundary. A misfield near the ropes too. A short ball outside off, Janat slaps this one over covers, where the man in the deep, misfields and lets the ball through.

EDGY FOUR. A streaky boundary but Afghanistan will take it, with both hands! A full toss, outside off, Karim Janat swings his blade at this one but the ball takes the edge and goes through short third man for a boundary.
Fuller, around off, slightly slow, tucked to the wide long on region for a single.
Full toss on middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye. On the pads, full, Ghani misses his flick and the ball takes the pad and rolls to the leg side. They sneak in a leg bye.
Faraz Akram is back on. 2-0-13-0 from him so far.
On middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.

IN THE AIR...SAFE! Janat not getting the timing on this one but luckily for him, he survives. Floated around off, Karim Janat just swings his blade at this and sends the ball high into the air towards the cover region. It lands safe as there was no one there. One run.
Full, tossed up, outside off, slammed away to sweeper cover for a single.
Around off, floated, kept out.
Short again, around off, cut away to the man at backward point.
Short and on middle, bunted to the mid on region for a single.
Ryan Burl is into the act now.
On a shortish length, just on off, Usman Ghani pulls this one awkwardly to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple of runs. A tidy over by Blessing, just 4 off this one.
On a good length, around the off pole, Ghani comes ahead and pushes the ball back onto the turf. Wants the single but his partner sends him back.
Angled around off again, on a back of a length, punched, but only to the point fielder.
Around off, punched by Janat to the deep cover region for a single.
Short of a length, around off, guided to third man for a single. 50 up for Afghanistan!
Bowls a shortish length ball outside off, generates good amount of bounce as the ball goes to the keeper. UG looks to slash but missed it.
Blessing Muzarabani is back on.
Flighted on middle, Ghani flicks this through mid-wicket for a single. A good start by Raza. Only 6 off this one.
Full, floated, around off, slogged away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on middle yet again, Ghani whips this one to the left of the deep square leg fielder. One run.
Flatter again and on middle, nudged to the on side for a single by KJ.
Flat, on middle, flicked to square leg for one.
Leg bye. On a shortish length, on middle and leg, Janat looks to flick but misses and the ball goes to the leg side, off the pads for a leg bye.
Sikandar Raza comes onto bowl now.
Short of a length ball around off, Usman keeps this one out. Afghanistan are at 43/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Width given as this is outside off, back of a length, slapped to the third man for a single.
Around off, on a good length, Janat pokes this one to the fielder at point.
Who comes out to bat now? Karim Janat is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant bowling and this delivery is a peach from Richard! Gets the breakthrough on this occasion and Gurbaz goes back for a low score again. On a good length, angled across the right-hander as Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to have a feel of this. Only manages an outside edge which is pouched easily by Richmond Mutumbami. This is almost similar to the way Gurbaz got out in the second T20I too.
Short of a length and around off, guided to third man for a single.
FOUR! Starts with a loosener and this has been sent packing to the ropes. Shortish and on the body, Usman Ghani pulls this one with power, through backward square leg and into the ropes.
Richard Ngarava is back on. 1-0-10-0 from him so far.
Back of a hand slower ball on a fuller length, Gurbaz mistimes the drive to mid off.
Shorter and closer to off, Ghani dabs it to point for a single.
FOUR! Handsomely done! Full toss outside off, Ghani creams the drive through covers and the ball runs away to the fence in no time.
Slower ball on the pads, Gurbaz flicks it to square leg for a single.
Another fuller one around off, Gurbaz again plays the drive but finds mid off again.
A huge grunt from Gurbaz as he fails to nail the full toss. He manages only to play it to mid off.
Short of length and outside off, Gurbaz cuts it hard but cannot get it past cover-point.
Good length and outside off, Gurbaz makes a leave.
SIX! Clobbered! Short and around middle, Gurbaz stays on the back foot as he pulls it handsomely over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. First one off the game.
Short of good length and around off, Gurbaz hops and keeps it to covers.
Length and outside off, Ghani runs it down to third man for a single.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Short and around leg, Ghani pulls it up and over short fine leg as the ball races to the boundary.
Fuller again from Faraz and Ghani stokes it to the off side for yet another run.
Full and swinging into Ghani, Usman tucks it to mid-wicket. The call was for two runs but they settle for a single only.
Fuller now and around off, Ghani drives it to cover-point and scampers for a single.
FOUR! Chopped away! Poor from Akram. Short and wide outside off, Ghani waits for the ball before cutting it past point as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Full and shaping into Ghani, Usman pushes it to covers.
Full and angled on the pads, Gurbaz looks to tuck it but he misses as the ball goes off his pads to short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
On a length and around leg, flicked to mid-wicket for a single. 10 runs off Richard Ngarava's first over.
Change. Faraz Akram to have a crack now.
FOUR! Another hit! Short and around leg, Gurbaz pulls it but not off the middle of the bat. He still manages to place it past short fine leg for a boundary.

FOUR! In the air... Just over! Length ball around off, Gurbaz skips down the track and looks to hammer it over mid off. He does so very closely as the ball elopes the leaping Sean Williams there for a boundary.
Short of length and angled across off , Gurbaz watches the ball and then makes the leave. The bounce should excite Williams.
Richard Ngarava strays one on the pads this time as Ghani tucks it to square leg for a single. He gets off the mark here.
Length and angled across Ghani, Usman shuffles across his off pole before tapping it to covers.
Flighted around off, Gurbaz looks to go for the sweep but is beaten all ends up. A good first over from Wellington Masakadza to start for Zimbabwe.
WIDE! Flat and down leg, Gurbaz misses his tuck. WIde called.
Will it be pace from the other end? Yep, it will be. Here's Richard Ngarava!
Another floated ball on off, Gurbaz once again lines up to go over extra cover but ends up playing it to covers.
Quicker and around middle, Gurbaz strokes it to the leg side.
Flighted around off, Gurbaz looks to go downtown but ends up hitting it to mid off.
Darted on middle, Gurbaz keeps it out off the back foot to the off side this time.
Masakadza starts with a tossed up ball on the pads, Gurbaz pushed it back to the bowler.

Right. Done with all the pre-match formalities and the action is all set to begin. The players from Zimbabwe make their way out and spread out on the field. The openers for Afghanistan, Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Usman Ghani stride out too. Spin to start off as Wellington Masakadza to begin with the ball. Here he comes...

Zimbabwe skipper, Sean Williams says that they would have batted as well. Mentions they had the opportunity in the first game but they did not do well. He mentions that there are few bowlers who have bowled well in the last game. He mentions that the spinners do it for them today.

Asghar Afghan, the Afghanistan skipper, says that the wicket is looking good and they plan to score well and put some runs on the board. Feels that their top 2-3 batters have done very well in the previous T20Is and today is a new day and hopes that they do well here today. States that each game is important for them. Informs that they have two changes.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo is down for the pitch report. He says that the pitch is the same as yesterday and there are some cracks that are opening up slightly and there is a darker tinge on the deck. Says that he is not sure that this deck will provide the same amount of runs, as it did yesterday. Feels that the captain winning the toss should bat first and put runs on the board.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Tinashe Kamunhukamwe, Tarisai Musakanda, Sean Williams (C), Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Richmond Mutumbami (WK), Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava, Milton Shumba (IN FOR WESLEY MADHEVERE), Faraz Akram (IN FOR DONALD TIRIPANO), Wellington Masakadza (IN FOR BRENDON MAVUTA).

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Usman Ghani, Karim Janat, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Asghar Afghan (C), Rashid Khan, Hashmatullah Shahidi, Fazalhaq Farooqi (IN FOR FARID MALIK), Naveen-ul-Haq, Sharafuddin Ashraf (IN FOR AMIR HAMZA).

TOSS - Time for the flip of the coin. Asghar Afghan and Sean Williams are out in the middle. Asghar Afghan flips the coin in the air. It lands in favour of Asghar Afghan. AFGHANISTAN OPT TO BAT FIRST!

Back-to-back T20I games always is a risk, as the possibility of picking up an injury increases, with less time to recover. But this has been the norm in this era of new normal as Afghanistan and Zimbabwe fight it out for one last time in the T20I series. Having already pocketed the series, Afghanistan would look to test their bench strength ahead of the T20 World Cup later this year. While Zimbabwe would also play without any pressure or baggage as they look for a consolation win. Though they won't be a part of the mega event but a win would be a huge confidence booster before they host Pakistan. Will Afghanistan clean-sweep the series or will Zimbabwe end with a consolation win? Let's find out as the toss and team news coming up shortly.
